title.narrative: Tripartite constituents have facilitated decent work for women and men and have new and revised decent work enabling legislation, and responsive labour market institutions and mechanisms

description.narrative: This initiative supports Afghanistan’s constituents in advancing decent work and gender equality amid ongoing political and economic challenges and weak institutions. It aims to strengthen national, local and private sector capacities to respond to crises by linking humanitarian, development, and peacebuilding efforts, while creating immediate, decent jobs that generate poverty-reducing income for vulnerable Afghans. Through the Employment-Intensive Investment Programme (EIIP), the programme enhances access to employment opportunities, career guidance, and entrepreneurship support, contributing to stronger and more responsive labour market systems. In addition, the interventions promote equality and inclusion in the world of work by engaging employers’ organizations to address discrimination and stigma faced by women, persons with disabilities, ethnic and minority groups, and people with diverse sexual orientations and gender identities. It further seeks to improve the coherence of national and community responses to crises and to strengthen resilience through employment-intensive green works and climate adaptation initiatives. By fostering inclusive labour market mechanisms and enabling institutions, these initiatives contribute to Sustainable Development Goals 5 and 8, empowering women and promoting sustained, inclusive, and productive employment for all. Amid Afghanistan’s complex political and economic environment, characterized by security risks, fiscal limitations, and institutional challenges, the intervention fosters greater cooperation, policy coherence, and data-driven decision-making. It particularly emphasizes advancing women’s economic participation and empowerment despite prevailing restrictions, contributing to gender equality and the creation of sustainable, decent work opportunities for all.
